title: Add uploaded banner to Home page hero and switch site theme to navy/faint blue

requirements.text: Add the uploaded image (photo_2026-02-13_15-36-18-1.jpg) as a top-of-home-page banner in the Home page hero section, displayed above the main heading and centered, responsive, and not distorted.

quotes: use this at top of home page and colur thim of our website is neavy bilue fain blue

acceptanceCriteria: The image file is added to the frontend as a static asset (do not serve it from the backend).
Home page renders the banner at the very top of the hero section (before the H2 heading).
Banner is responsive (scales down on mobile) and maintains aspect ratio (no stretching).
Image includes appropriate English alt text (e.g., "Concept Delta banner").

requirements.text: Update the global UI color theme to navy blue with faint/light blue accents across the site (backgrounds, buttons, links, icons, cards, borders) by adjusting the existing CSS theme tokens/variables so all Shadcn/Tailwind components inherit the new palette consistently in light and dark modes.

quotes: colur thim of our website is neavy bilue fain blue

acceptanceCriteria: The primary color is navy blue and secondary/accent colors are faint/light blue (no earth-tone/terracotta palette remains).
Buttons, links, and icon highlights use the updated primary/secondary tokens (e.g., components using text-primary/bg-primary reflect the new navy).
Light mode and dark mode both remain readable with sufficient contrast (foreground text is legible on background and primary surfaces).
No changes are made to files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose/override via tokens and Tailwind usage only).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Backend must remain single-actor; do not introduce additional canisters/services.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Changing predictor logic, CSV import behavior, or backend data models.
Adding new pages or navigation items beyond styling and the Home page top banner.
